title: Whole Life Insurance Owner Elections: Reduced Paid-Up Insurance and the Automatic Premium Loan
content:
## Reduced paid-up election

An owner of a premium-paying Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy may stop premiums and continue it as reduced paid-up insurance by signed request, effective on the paid-to date. Any loan is extinguished against the cash value first. Dividends continue on the reduced face where the tier is participating.

**Retired clause.** The former clause stating that the reduced face is the net cash value divided by the net single premium per 1,000 times 1,000, rounded to the dollar, and must be at least the tier's smallest reduced paid-up face, is **no longer in force**. It is superseded by the current Ashgrove basis for the reduced paid-up face at an owner's election.

## Automatic premium loan election

An automatic premium loan election may be made or revoked by the owner at any time while the policy is premium-paying on a tier where the automatic premium loan is available. An automatic premium loan election change is accepted only while the policy status is in force or in the grace period, as shown on the system record of that policy. The change applies to installments whose grace period has not yet ended.

| Policy status on the record | Election or revocation accepted |
|---|---|
| In force | Yes |
| Grace period | Yes |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical)

- An owner revokes the automatic premium loan while an installment due on May 1 is in grace with its last day of grace on June 1: the revocation applies to that installment, because its grace period has not yet ended.
- A reduced paid-up election on a policy whose paid-to date is September 15 takes effect on September 15.
- On the Ashgrove Final Expense Whole Life and the Ashgrove Single Premium Whole Life the automatic premium loan is not available, so no election is made on those tiers.

superseded_clauses: the reduced face is the net cash value divided by rpu_nsp_per_thousand times 1,000, rounded to the dollar, and must be at least rpu_min_face_amount
